title: Image-to-Video Prompts: 30 Examples + Fixes
summary: Write image-to-video prompts that control subject, camera and scene motion. Copy 30 examples and fix drift, warping, unwanted cuts and weak movement.
body_markdown:
Quick Answer


## Quick answer


For image-to-video, let the image define appearance and use the prompt to direct motion. A reliable starting structure is: **subject action + environmental motion + camera behavior + timing or continuity constraint** . Begin with the one movement that matters most, generate a short proof, and change one instruction at a time.


Starting image


Prompt should describe


Avoid repeating


Portrait


Expression, gesture, hair or clothing motion, camera


Age, clothes, facial details already visible


Product photo


Product interaction, reflections, particles, camera path


Brand, packaging and materials already established


Landscape


Weather, water, foliage, atmosphere and camera


Static geography and color palette


Illustration


Animation style, layer motion and timing


Characters and composition already present


## The image-to-video prompt formula


The \[subject\] \[visible action\]. \[Environmental motion\]. The camera \[one movement or locked behavior\]. \[Speed, timing or continuity\].


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520%255Bsubject%255D%2520%255Bvisible%2520action%255D.%2520%255BEnvironmental%2520motion%255D.%2520The%2520camera%2520%255Bone%2520movement%2520or%2520locked%2520behavior%255D.%2520%255BSpeed%252C%2520timing%2520or%2520continuity%255D.)


This differs from text-to-video, where the prompt must establish both what the shot looks like and what moves. In image-to-video, the reference frame already supplies the subject, composition, lighting and style. Runway’s current[image-to-video prompting guide](https://help.runwayml.com/hc/en-us/articles/48324313115155-Image-to-Video-Prompting-Guide) likewise recommends focusing on motion and starting simply. Treat that as model-specific guidance, not a universal guarantee: different models interpret wording differently.


## Portrait prompts


The subject gives a small natural smile and blinks once. A light breeze moves a few strands of hair. Locked camera, subtle motion only.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520subject%2520gives%2520a%2520small%2520natural%2520smile%2520and%2520blinks%2520once.%2520A%2520light%2520breeze%2520moves%2520a%2520few%2520strands%2520of%2520hair.%2520Locked%2520camera%252C%2520subtle%2520motion%2520only.)


The subject turns slowly toward the window, then holds their gaze. Soft curtain movement in the background. Gentle handheld camera.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520subject%2520turns%2520slowly%2520toward%2520the%2520window%252C%2520then%2520holds%2520their%2520gaze.%2520Soft%2520curtain%2520movement%2520in%2520the%2520background.%2520Gentle%2520handheld%2520camera.)


The subject takes one calm breath and lifts their chin slightly. Fabric moves naturally at the shoulders. Static close-up.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520subject%2520takes%2520one%2520calm%2520breath%2520and%2520lifts%2520their%2520chin%2520slightly.%2520Fabric%2520moves%2520naturally%2520at%2520the%2520shoulders.%2520Static%2520close-up.)


The subject looks down, then meets the camera with a restrained smile. Slow push-in, continuous shot.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520subject%2520looks%2520down%252C%2520then%2520meets%2520the%2520camera%2520with%2520a%2520restrained%2520smile.%2520Slow%2520push-in%252C%2520continuous%2520shot.)


The subject walks two measured steps toward camera. Clothing responds naturally. The camera tracks backward at the same pace.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520subject%2520walks%2520two%2520measured%2520steps%2520toward%2520camera.%2520Clothing%2520responds%2520naturally.%2520The%2520camera%2520tracks%2520backward%2520at%2520the%2520same%2520pace.)


## Product prompts


Condensation rolls slowly down the bottle while cool mist drifts behind it. The camera makes a slow 20-degree arc from left to right.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Condensation%2520rolls%2520slowly%2520down%2520the%2520bottle%2520while%2520cool%2520mist%2520drifts%2520behind%2520it.%2520The%2520camera%2520makes%2520a%2520slow%252020-degree%2520arc%2520from%2520left%2520to%2520right.)


The watch remains centered as the second hand moves and a narrow highlight travels across the glass. Locked macro camera.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520watch%2520remains%2520centered%2520as%2520the%2520second%2520hand%2520moves%2520and%2520a%2520narrow%2520highlight%2520travels%2520across%2520the%2520glass.%2520Locked%2520macro%2520camera.)


Coffee pours into the cup in one continuous stream. Steam curls upward. Slow push-in at table height.

[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520sneaker%2520rotates%2520a%2520quarter%2520turn%2520on%2520the%2520pedestal.%2520Soft%2520dust%2520lifts%2520at%2520the%2520base.%2520The%2520camera%2520remains%2520fixed.)


The package opens cleanly and the product rises slightly into view. One continuous shot, controlled studio motion.

## Camera-motion prompts


The camera performs a slow push-in and stops before reaching the subject. Everything else remains calm.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520camera%2520performs%2520a%2520slow%2520push-in%2520and%2520stops%2520before%2520reaching%2520the%2520subject.%2520Everything%2520else%2520remains%2520calm.)


The camera tracks left while keeping the subject centered. Natural parallax separates foreground and background.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=The%2520camera%2520tracks%2520left%2520while%2520keeping%2520the%2520subject%2520centered.%2520Natural%2520parallax%2520separates%2520foreground%2520and%2520background.)


A gentle handheld camera follows the subject from behind. No change of scene.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=A%2520gentle%2520handheld%2520camera%2520follows%2520the%2520subject%2520from%2520behind.%2520No%2520change%2520of%2520scene.)


The camera rises vertically to reveal the landscape beyond the foreground wall. Smooth crane movement.

Locked-off camera. Minimal subject motion only. The first and last frame should feel visually continuous.

## Five prompts for common failures


Too much camera motion: Locked camera. The subject performs one small movement; the framing remains unchanged.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Too%2520much%2520camera%2520motion%253A%2520Locked%2520camera.%2520The%2520subject%2520performs%2520one%2520small%2520movement%253B%2520the%2520framing%2520remains%2520unchanged.)


Frozen output: The subject takes one clear step forward as fabric and hair respond naturally. A slow push-in follows.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Frozen%2520output%253A%2520The%2520subject%2520takes%2520one%2520clear%2520step%2520forward%2520as%2520fabric%2520and%2520hair%2520respond%2520naturally.%2520A%2520slow%2520push-in%2520follows.)


Unwanted cut: One continuous shot. The action unfolds in the same location without a transition.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Unwanted%2520cut%253A%2520One%2520continuous%2520shot.%2520The%2520action%2520unfolds%2520in%2520the%2520same%2520location%2520without%2520a%2520transition.)


Identity drift: The subject remains recognizable and performs a small natural gesture. Avoid requesting a simultaneous transformation.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Identity%2520drift%253A%2520The%2520subject%2520remains%2520recognizable%2520and%2520performs%2520a%2520small%2520natural%2520gesture.%2520Avoid%2520requesting%2520a%2520simultaneous%2520transformation.)


Chaotic product motion: The product remains rigid and centered while only the light and camera move.


[Try in Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/create/image-to-video?prompt=Chaotic%2520product%2520motion%253A%2520The%2520product%2520remains%2520rigid%2520and%2520centered%2520while%2520only%2520the%2520light%2520and%2520camera%2520move.)


### Animate a still image


Upload one strong source image, choose an image-to-video model, start with the essential motion, and revise one variable after reviewing the first clip.


[Try Image-to-Video](https://magichour.ai/products/image-to-video)


## How to improve a prompt without wasting generations


-


Inspect the input first. Blur, malformed hands, unreadable packaging or contradictory motion cues can become more visible after animation.


-


Start with the subject’s essential action. Add environmental or camera movement only after that action works.


-


Request one shot. Several locations, transformations or camera moves compete for a short clip’s limited time.


-


Use positive, visible language. Describe what the camera and subject should do rather than writing a long list of prohibitions.


-


Change one variable per attempt so you can tell which instruction helped.


-


Set duration, aspect ratio and model in the interface when those controls are available; words do not override unavailable settings.


## Choose image-to-video or text-to-video


Choose image-to-video when a person, product, composition or art direction must begin from an approved frame. Choose[text-to-video](https://magichour.ai/products/text-to-video) when you want the model to invent the entire shot. For a deeper workflow comparison, see[text-to-video versus image-to-video](https://magichour.ai/blog/text-to-video-vs-image-to-video-ai-tools) . For broader camera and lighting language, use the[cinematic prompt cookbook](https://magichour.ai/blog/cinematic-ai-video-prompt-cookbook) .


## Frequently asked questions


###


Describe the subject’s action, relevant environmental motion, one camera behavior and any timing or continuity requirement. Do not spend most of the prompt redescribing visual details already established by the image.


###


Use the shortest prompt that clearly describes the intended shot. A single sentence can be enough for simple motion. Add detail only to correct a specific mismatch.


###


Large movements, turns, transformations, occlusion and weak source images can make identity harder to preserve. Start with a sharp portrait and smaller motion, then increase complexity gradually.


###


That depends on the selected model. Some models respond better to positive descriptions of the desired state. Put universal requirements in plain positive language and consult the model’s current documentation for negative-prompt support.


###


Generate controlled shots separately and edit them together. Some workflows also let you use a finished clip’s last frame as the next starting image, but continuity still requires review.
